v1.name: ask_forecast_door_scored

body.text: Will protests intensify nationwide this month?

result.question: Will protests intensify nationwide this month?
result.semantics_note: normalized branch-displacement ratio; not a calibrated event probability (see SEMANTICS_BINARY_READOUT.md)
result.answer: Earth-1 simulates p=0.38 (tier UNCALIBRATED; strongest force channel: fear).

v1.note: 'will …' routes to the FORECAST door: real branch runs vs null. horizon_days is clamped to 1..365 (default 45 on the 20k sync path). p_model is a normalized branch-displacement ratio (semantics: branch_consistency), not a calibrated event probability. Captured against the tiny synthetic world, so the numbers are shape-only

v1.name: ask_forecast_door_abstain

body.text: Will protests intensify nationwide this month?

result.question: Will protests intensify nationwide this month?
result.abstain_reason: all branch deltas below class noise floor 0.02498 (branch = control)
result.semantics_note: normalized branch-displacement ratio; not a calibrated event probability (see SEMANTICS_BINARY_READOUT.md)
result.answer: The simulation abstains (all branch deltas below class noise floor 0.02498 (branch = control)); no grounded fact answers it either — the abstention reason is the answer.

v1.note: ABSTAIN is a first-class outcome: when every branch delta sits below the class noise floor, p_model is null and abstain_reason says so — the surface never serves a number from an abstained line. country scopes both the dose and the readout to that ISO2
